previous_statement: Put J={1,...,m}, let {e_j} be the projection basis of C^m, set P_j=w(e_j), R=w(I_{C^m}), and t=W.K_call*epsilon. Then A is an extended t-C*-algebra, every P_j and R is a t-projection, ||R-I_A|| <= W.c0_cb*epsilon <= t, every P_j is one-dimensional, and j~k iff dim S^A_{P_j,P_k}=1 is an equivalence relation with a finite class family C.
new_statement: Put the nonempty set J={1,...,m}, let {e_j} be the projection basis of C^m, set P_j=w(e_j), R=w(I_{C^m}), and t=W.K_call*epsilon. Then A is an extended t-C*-algebra, every P_j and R is a t-projection, ||R-I_A|| <= W.c0_cb*epsilon <= t, every P_j is one-dimensional, and j~k iff dim S^A_{P_j,P_k}=1 is an equivalence relation with a finite nonempty class family C.
